**Finding: compliant (EXCLUSIVITY).**

The agreement contains no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements-purchase obligation on Clear Capital. The engagement is structured task-by-task under Statements of Work (p0004), leaving us free to source comparable services elsewhere. The only "exclusive" references are Contractor's ownership of its own pre-existing materials (p0020), the non-exclusive licence granted *to* us (p0021), and the entire-agreement clause (p0051); the mutual employee non-solicitation (p0047) is a personnel restriction, not a sourcing restriction. This satisfies the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
